fixtureScope: Fictional display-only learner; states produced in memory by the actual engine and plan commands; API responses fulfilled in the browser and never sent to the Worker or saved.
limits: Local loopback GET/HEAD only; no account, enrolment, plan or reflection was persisted anywhere.
The /api/academy and /api/teams GET envelopes mirror the route source; server routes and D1 were not exercised.
Page clock fixed per scenario; this checks current-week display, not real elapsed time.
Service workers blocked so every request passed the read-only guard; the app registers none.
32px body text tests text enlargement, not browser zoom; layout checks are not a formal accessibility audit.
